visual_logic.surface_detail: Soft, pebbled lizard scales with a slight iridescent sheen; moss-green dorsal palette transitioning to a pale cream underbelly, running uniformly across its extended horizontal profile.
visual_logic.environment: Shallow brackish water with floating 'Salviniales' (water ferns). All plant elements are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.
visual_logic.cinematic_effect: Subtle 'god-rays' penetrating the water to highlight the volume of the body, directed horizontally across the frame to illuminate the lateral profile cleanly.

pose: The snake-like marine lizard is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original playful coiled pose around a branch is unrolled into a flat, level, straight cruising path. This configuration stretches its curious head, elongated neck, slender snake-like torso, vestigial limbs, and long tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system for precise top-by-bottom length analysis.
